info.title: ApiToolKit - Google Merchant API
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for Merchant API (replaces the Content API for Shopping): every v1 sub-API - accounts, conversions, data sources, inventories, issue resolution, local feeds partnership, notifications, order tracking, products, promotions, quota, reports and reviews - plus the v1alpha merchant reviews and Product Studio APIs. Connect a Google account with GET /api/merchant/auth/url?accountKey=..., then pass the same accountKey to every endpoint.
